values.binNote: No bin calculation directly outputs the doubled minion values; the bin's LucianR#DamagePerBullet only computes the per-champion instance from BaseDamage/DamageADRatio/DamageAPRatio. The wiki derives the minion row by multiplying those same base values by PercentDamageAmpToMinions=200 (i.e. x2.0), matching the wiki's stated 30/60/90 base and 0.5/0.3 ratios; the multiplier itself is not applied within any bin calculation row shown.

values.meaning: number of shots fired over the duration
extra bonus shots per 100% crit chance
values.binNote: The bin's LucianR#TotalNumShots formula is (1 + CritValueMod*critChance*(critDamage-1)) * NumShots=22, which depends on critDamage as well as critChance, not a flat 22.222 shots per 100% crit chance. The wiki's 22.222 figure (from the {{critical damage|...|critScaling=true}} template) appears to assume a specific critDamage value not shown as a discrete row in this sheet; CritValueMod=1 and NumShots=22 are the only directly matching rows, and neither alone equals 22.222, so the exact per-crit-chance scaling cannot be reconciled from the sheet as given.

mechanics.claim: While channeling, Lucian is ghosted and may still move.
mechanics.quote: While channeling, '''Lucian''' is {{tip|ghosted}} and may still move.

mechanics.claim: The Culling can be recast to end the channel early, and recasts automatically when the channel ends.
mechanics.quote: ''The Culling'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds during the channel, and does so automatically when the channel ends.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the ability ends (post-effect), not on cast.
Each bullet's damage is calculated on impact, like single missile abilities, meaning each shot is a separate damage instance.
mechanics.quote: The damage dealt by each bullet of ''The Culling'' is calculated when the bullet reaches a target, just like single missile abilities.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield only blocks one instance of damage from the channel, not the whole thing.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} only blocks one instance of damage.

mechanics.claim: Fire rate increases with the number of shots fired.
mechanics.quote: The fire rate increases with the number of shots.

mechanics.claim: Piercing Light and Ardent Blaze are disabled while channeling.
